To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Dol10-based ADCs are potent in inhibiting tumor growth in a mouse tumor model and the PEG8-DL-ADCs are more efficacious than the ADCs containing PGE3 and PEG6 spacers.
Dol10 based drug linker conjugated to antibody is an effective anticancer agent in vivo.
Dol10-based ADCs containing hydrophilic linkers are potent in vitro and in vivo anticancer agents.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of Dol10-based ADCs for the treatment of solid tumors.
the synthesis and biological evaluation of Dol10 containing ADC drug-linkers with different PEG chain lengths.
the synthesis of Dol10 containing ADC linkers, which could be used for the preparation of ADCs for the treatment of cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Dol10 containing ADC with PEG6 and/or PEG8 spacer showed the best in vitro and in vivo efficacy.
the ADCs prepared in this study have shown promising results and are worthy of further development.

the Dol10 based ADCs with a PEG8 spacer exhibited the highest in vitro anti-prolif-erative activity against HER-2 positive tumor cells and in vivo anti-tumor activity against SKOV-3 tumor xenografts in nude mice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the PEG chain of the drug linkers plays a significant role in determining the biological activity of Dol10-ADCs.

we have developed an efficient and modular approach for the synthesis of Dol10 based drug linker for ADCs and the biological activities of the ADCs were dependent on the chain length of the PEG spacer in the drug linker.
the Dol10 drug linkers containing PEG6 or PEG8 spacer chains were found to be the most suitable for the development of ADCs.
The main takeaway from our work is that

Dol10 containing ADC can be prepared in a convergent manner by coupling Dol10 with PEG-maleimido tetrapeptide intermediates, and that the presence of PEG chain in drug linker is essential for the in vivo stability of ADCs.
ADCs derived from Dol10 and Herceptin®, containing a PEG8 linker, are highly efficacious in the treatment of human ovarian SKOV3 xenograft tumors.
Dol10 can be efficiently conjugated to antibodies using the synthetic strategy reported here.
